cards.title: How statuses work today
cards.text: Every status builds up to 100, then something bigger happens. Here's each one. Mark any part that's off.
cards.why: The questions after this one are about what comes next, so it helps to see what's there.

parts.title: Burn to Scorch
parts.text: Burn hurts over time. At 100 it drops to 20, the unit takes a big hit, and a small fire explosion goes off that burns those nearby.

parts.title: Chill to Freeze to Shatter
parts.text: Chill slows, up to 60%. At 100 the unit freezes for 3 seconds (the boss 1.6). A hard hit while frozen shatters it into 8 icicles that chill whoever they hit. Each freeze makes the next one harder.

parts.title: Poison to Rot
parts.text: Poison hurts over time. At 100 it rots: 15% of max HP at once. An enemy that dies badly poisoned leaves a gas cloud.

parts.title: How they mix
parts.text: Fire thaws ice and burns chill away. Fire turns oil into fire and makes gas explode. Fire arrows set off oil and gas they fly through.

parts.title: Friendly fire
parts.text: Explosions and shatter icicles also hit your own heroes, at 40%.

parts.title: Who causes what
parts.text: Archer: chill on every arrow, fire arrows in Barrage. Rogue: poison. Knight: none, but his heavy hits shatter. Rings add any of the three. Enemies cause none.

cards.title: The next status
cards.text: Which status we talked about should come next?
cards.why: Each one adds new combos. The first one in decides which new hero or ring brings it.

options.label: Wet and Shock
options.text: Shock chains at Overload. Wet doubles shock, halves burn.

options.label: Bleed
options.text: Hemorrhage: a big hit; moving bleeds faster.

options.label: Stagger
options.text: Heavy hits build to Topple: knocked flat briefly.

options.label: Steam
options.text: Fire on ice makes steam that blocks line of sight.

cards.title: New heroes' statuses
cards.text: Each hero now has its own status (archer chill, rogue poison). What should farmer and barbarian bring?
cards.why: A status per hero means every party you build combines differently.
cards.pick: Barbarian: bleed. Farmer: stagger from heavy knock-back swings, which also sets up the knight's shatters.
cards.details: The knight stays status-free, as the one who cashes in: his heavy hits shatter, and his Charge sends enemies into hazards.

cards.title: Enemies causing statuses
cards.text: No enemy causes a status yet. Should some?
cards.why: Right now statuses only ever help you. An enemy that sets your knight on fire next to oil makes rooms more dangerous and more interesting to watch.
cards.pick: Yes, one each: rat bites bleed, slimes leave wet puddles, skeletons cause nothing but resist poison (as now).

cards.title: Keep friendly fire?
cards.text: Explosions and icicles hit your own heroes at 40%. Keep it?
cards.why: It makes the knight charging into oil while the archer fires fire arrows a real risk, which is fun to watch. It also costs runs that feel unfair.
cards.pick: Keep it, and teach the brains to stay out of oil and gas when a fire is likely.
